diagnosis.actual_observation: The current installed DesktopFrame does not expose keyboard_actions; the probe failed on that lookup before any keyboard composition, persistence, conflict, reading-copy or backup assertions.
diagnosis.source_contract: DesktopFrame calls install_productivity_actions, which explicitly retains KeyboardActions only for historical keymap validation and installs the single shared KeyboardManager as keyboard_commands. Its bindings are keyed by stable ID; apply_overrides validates native keys, updates the actual menus and saves through KeymapStore.
diagnosis.current_store: KeyboardManager.store.path is inside the selected library and identifies keyboard-shortcuts.json. The current complete-backup producer explicitly inventories and validates that file.
diagnosis.no_product_defect_inferred: The actual trace proves the missing fixture attribute. Current source establishes the owner/API migration; this document does not infer execution of any skipped keyboard or backup action.

correction.owner: Use frame.keyboard_commands, without constructing a second keyboard manager or historical KeybindingStore.
correction.inventory: Use the existing read-only productivity.collect_commands on the complete current native menu bar. The current registry itself uses this helper; this preserves all original path-based expected shortcuts and also includes commands installed after manager creation.
correction.registered_save: Resolve the existing File/Save current changes identity through keyboard.legacy_command_ids and require its current manager binding to own the exact same native item before the unchanged EVT_MENU Save dispatch.
correction.mutation_and_persistence: Use current apply_overrides with the stable Save ID and reopen the actual KeymapStore path. The keymap path must be relative to the selected library; restore checks read that same relative path in the restored library.
correction.conflict: Retain the deliberate Ctrl+I conflict, ValueError requirement and unchanged complete native-menu labels after refusal.
correction.retained_flow: The original eight expected shortcuts, exact native menu Save event, note assertion, reading-copy editor/timer/draft/source-byte checks, reading state and backup checks remain. The original final receipt and cleanup block are byte-identical.
correction.bounds: Existing pump timeout 15 seconds, reading modal watchdog 15000 ms, command arguments, workflow step bounds and orchestration are unchanged.
